meeting_summary: Meeting addressed critical warehouse operational issues including delayed shipments, inventory mismatches, and customer complaints. Immediate corrective actions were decided including re-slotting overflow inventory, creating dedicated pick lanes, and implementing staging verification processes.

key_topics.summary: Overflow inventory in zones B and C is blocking picking lines, causing forklift and picker traffic conflicts that delay operations.
Three handheld scanners went offline Tuesday, forcing manual entries, while new temp workers lack proper scanning and labeling training.
Manual entries and process breakdowns have created mismatches between system records and actual warehouse floor inventory.
Informal handoff process between staging and dispatch has led to incomplete orders and missed carrier cutoffs.

decisions.decision: Re-slot overflow inventory out of zones B and C starting today
decisions.context: To eliminate traffic congestion between forklifts and pickers

decisions.decision: Set up a pick-only lane during peak hours
decisions.context: To prevent forklifts from blocking order selectors

decisions.decision: Implement mandatory staging verification check before dispatch confirmation
decisions.context: To prevent incomplete orders from being marked as ready for shipping

decisions.decision: Remove temp workers from independent picking until retrained
decisions.context: To eliminate scanning and labeling errors caused by inadequate training

decisions.decision: Teams will share scanners until repairs are completed
decisions.context: Three scanners are offline with repairs expected by tomorrow afternoon
